meeting_window.summary: 會議主要涵蓋兩大主題。首先，團隊討論了近期關於長文本處理和評估方法的研究論文。他們分析了一篇2024年關於序列化代理摘要的論文，指出了其潛在的錯誤傳播和缺乏全域上下文等問題。接著，他們檢視了MAM-0和MAREX兩篇論文的評估方法，討論了Locomo數據集、多跳問題（multi-hop questions）等不同問題類型，以及使用LLM作為評審的評分方式。第二個主要議題是提出一個關於「永續AI」的新專案構想，旨在衡量大型語言模型的計算成本，並探索以人為本的方法來降低能源消耗。
key_points: 序列化代理摘要論文（2024）：討論了一篇使用代理鏈摘要長文本的論文。批評意見包括幻覺傳播的風險、缺乏共享的全域上下文（黑板），以及隨機文本分塊的問題。
評估方法（MAM-0 & MAREX）：回顧了兩篇用於評估記憶模型的論文。MAM-0：使用Locomo數據集與預定義問題，其主要優勢在於較低的token消耗，但在多跳問題上未超越RAG。MAREX：作為MAM-0的後續研究，評估了基於圖像的記憶，但其對基線模型和自家模型運行次數不一致的方法論受到質疑。
評估概念：澄清了「多跳」（需要多個推理步驟）和「時間推理」（會話摘要）等問題類型的定義。討論了使用LLM作為評審進行二元（正確/不正確）評估的方法。
新專案構想：永續AI：提出了一項新的合作計畫，旨在量化LLM的token和計算成本。該專案希望賦予使用者能力，為較簡單的任務選擇能源密集度較低的工具，從而引入一種以人為本的「永續AI」方法。
open_questions: 關於序列化摘要論文：整合輸出的『管理者代理』確切功能是什麼？
關於MAREX論文：為什麼基線模型只運行一次，而其提出的模型卻運行三次？
關於永續AI專案：如何準確計算GPT模型的token消耗和計算負載，並將其呈現給使用者以影響其行為？

meeting_window.summary: 本次會議為一位新參與者概述了專案的記憶系統，該系統分為工作、短期和長期三部分。討論的核心是改進系統架構，特別是長期記憶，提出從樹狀結構轉向基於檢索的系統，並使用時間衰減新近度分數來處理研究討論的非線性和迭代性質。團隊定義了一項核心評估任務：追蹤主題的生命週期以識別被探討後放棄的「死亡主題」，並將其視為與簡單RAG系統的關鍵區別。會議還涉及了ICSI資料集、相關研究（如'WebCAG'、'Digital-Meme'）、評估挑戰、跨記憶儲存的檢索權重，以及對模型人格/風格建模的初步探討。
key_points: 專案概覽：向新成員介紹了三層式記憶系統（工作、短期、長期），並強調了管理非線性研究討論的挑戰。(L107-126)
長期記憶重新設計：提議用基於檢索的系統取代樹狀結構，該系統使用時間衰減新近度分數，並為重要項目設置下限，以防止其被遺忘。(L1-8, L132-135)
核心評估任務：定義了一個關鍵目標，即追蹤主題的生命週期，特別是識別被討論後放棄的「死亡主題」。(L211-216)
架構挑戰：團隊指出了當前的問題，包括短期記憶變得過於龐大，以及如何權衡來自三個不同記憶儲存的檢索結果。(L127-131, L171-174)
資料集與前期研究：團隊正在使用ICSI語料庫，並積極研究記憶模型、會議摘要和評估的相關工作（例如'WebCAG', 'Digital-Meme'）。(L26-49, L96-106, L217-223)
優先級決策：團隊決定優先改進記憶系統，而不是為代理的「人格」建模，認為前者是更緊迫的挑戰。(L81-95)
open_questions: 如何最有效地加權和組合來自工作、短期和長期記憶儲存的檢索結果？(L171-174)
長期記憶的最佳保留策略是什麼？資訊應如何隨時間「淡出」？(L130-131)
鑑於資料集的局限性，如何有效評估模型對主題生命週期（特別是「死亡主題」）的記憶和理解？(L73-75, L212-216)
如何為代理的「風格」（例如，知道何時打斷）建模？是否應該採用內容優先，然後是風格的兩步法？(L206-210)

meeting_window.summary: 本次會議深入探討了 agent 的記憶系統架構，特別是短期與長期記憶之間的關係與更新機制。團隊回顧了現有的 L1-L3 三層階層式記憶結構，並討論了從逐字稿生成 L1 idea units 的過程。會議中提出了兩項重要的新方法：(1) 在 agent 的「使用階段」，利用 LLM 的 function-calling 功能，讓模型動態決定要查詢短期或長期記憶；(2) 在「更新階段」也採用類似方法，透過逐句分析，決定資訊應更新至哪個記憶庫。此外，會議也強調了為了提升 LLM 分析的準確性，需要對逐字稿進行預處理，將其切分為更小的 idea units。然而，關於記憶整合的具體標準、不同記憶類型間的確切關係等架構性問題仍待解決。
key_points: 團隊闡明了 L1 (單次會議筆記)、L2 (多次會議摘要) 與 L3 (最高層級摘要) 的三層式記憶架構。 (證據: L13-19)
一項核心架構提議是讓短期和長期記憶從原始逐字稿中獨立更新，而非讓資訊從短期依序流向長期記憶。 (證據: L91-94, L107)
針對 agent 的「使用階段」，提出讓 LLM 透過 function-calling 根據使用者問題，動態決定查詢短期或長期記憶，取代固定的系統邏輯。 (證據: L47-59, L66-79)
延伸 function-calling 的概念，建議在「更新階段」也導入此機制，透過逐句分析逐字稿，讓 LLM 決定該資訊要更新到短期還是長期記憶。 (證據: L109-113)
會議確定在將逐字稿交給 LLM 分析前，需先進行預處理，將其切分為「idea units」，以提高資訊抽取的準確度。 (證據: L39-45)
系統設計包含一個追蹤「重新出現主題」的機制，該機制使用基於「新近度 (Recency)」和「重要性 (Importance)」的評分系統，並設有衰減下限，以防主題被完全遺忘。 (證據: L22-25)
目前預設的 L1 物件類型 (如：決策、待辦事項、開放問題) 被視為一個有效的初步假設，同時也是系統當前的限制之一。 (證據: L31-38)
open_questions: 記憶鞏固機制：資訊被整合到長期記憶的具體標準是什麼（例如：頻率、重要性、時間衰減）？短期和長期記憶之間的更新流程與關係尚未最終確定。 (證據: L81-90, L107)
檢索分數權重：結合了語意相似度、新近度和重要性的檢索分數，其權重應如何計算與評估？ (證據: L26)
初始 Idea Unit 生成：從原始逐字稿中叢集並生成 L1「idea units」的最佳方法或 prompt 是什麼？ (證據: L27-30)
系統邏輯 vs. LLM 邏輯：團隊對於使用寫死的系統邏輯，或是讓 LLM 決定查詢哪個記憶庫的優劣進行了辯論，最佳方法仍在討論中。 (證據: L66-79)
定義記憶特徵：在此 agent 的架構中，短期和長期記憶在結構和內容上的明確差異是什麼（例如：節點數量、內容密度）？ (證據: L80)

action_items.detail: Update: The investigation has begun by reviewing the MAM-0 and MAREX papers, which share a common dataset from an ACL 2024 conference.

action_items.detail: A strategy has been decided: use the current free credit on one account until its expiration on April 26th, and only then activate the new lab credit to maximize the free usage period. This avoids having two credits active simultaneously.

action_items.title: Explore a human-centric approach to Sustainable AI
action_items.detail: Investigate and calculate the energy consumption (e.g., token usage, compute power) of different models like GPT. Explore a human-in-the-loop approach where users can choose power-saving modes (e.g., less powerful models) for simpler tasks.

action_items.title: Define and implement an evaluation task for tracking 'dead topics'
action_items.detail: Define a concrete evaluation metric for the memory system based on its ability to track the lifecycle of topics, identifying ones that were explored but later abandoned ('dead topics'). This is to differentiate the project from simple RAG. Consider using synthetic data with fake 'dead topics' to create testable scenarios.

action_items.title: Review the 'Digital-Meme' paper
action_items.detail: Review the 'Digital-Meme' paper to understand its approach to relevancy and memory, as suggested in the meeting.

action_items.title: Share Google Cloud account information
action_items.detail: SPEAKER_01 to share necessary Google Cloud account/API key information with the team to proceed with the credit usage plan.

action_items.title: Define a method to prove the value of the memory architecture
action_items.detail: Following the discussion on memory architecture, a next step was proposed to define a method to prove the value of having the proposed long-term memory architecture.

action_items.title: Define the relationship and update mechanism for memory architectures
action_items.detail: Clarify the relationship between short-term and long-term memory and define how they are updated, including how information transitions between them.

action_items.title: Implement pre-processing for meeting transcriptions
action_items.detail: Implement a pre-processing step for meeting transcriptions, such as splitting them into sentences, before feeding them into the memory update system to improve accuracy and enable more fine-grained control.

method_changes.before: The memory system uses absolute meeting IDs (e.g., '16', '17') to reference when an item was discussed.
method_changes.after: Proposed change to use relative time references (e.g., 'one week ago') for memory items.
method_changes.reason: A suggestion was made to make the timeline of memory items more intuitive and human-readable, changing from absolute meeting IDs to relative time.

method_changes.topic: Code development and data structure alignment
method_changes.after: The team decided to collaborate by modifying a shared open-source GitHub repository and align on a common folder structure.
method_changes.reason: To align development efforts and prevent data duplication, such as having multiple versions of meeting transcripts.

method_changes.before: Using a tree structure for long-term memory.
method_changes.after: Adopt an object-based structure for long-term memory, extracting specific object types like 'decision', 'to-do', 'method change', and 'result' from each meeting.
method_changes.reason: The team concluded that a complex tree structure is not necessary, and capturing the meeting's context through specific, extracted objects is more important than ensuring complete, lossless memory.

method_changes.topic: Transcript Pre-processing for Idea Unit Segmentation
method_changes.before: The entire transcript is fed as a single block to the LLM for analysis.
method_changes.after: A pre-processing step is added to segment the transcript into smaller idea units (e.g., by sentence or turn) before feeding them to the LLM.
method_changes.reason: To improve the accuracy and reduce hallucination of the LLM analysis by providing smaller, more focused contexts, as full-context analysis was found to be imprecise.

method_changes.topic: Dynamic Memory Update via LLM Function Calling
method_changes.before: The mechanism for updating short-term vs. long-term memory was handled by a more static process or was undefined.
method_changes.after: Adopt a strategy where the transcript is processed sentence-by-sentence. For each sentence, an LLM will use function-calling to dynamically decide whether to update short-term memory, long-term memory, or both.
method_changes.reason: This allows for more fine-grained, context-aware memory updates, enabling the system to intelligently handle scenarios like revisiting old topics by checking both short and long-term memory.

experiment_todos.description: Design and run an experiment to demonstrate the memory system's effectiveness, for example, by visualizing how an event's history is tracked by the agent compared to a baseline agent, or by designing questions that show different answers.
Research and review how related papers evaluate and prove their memory model's performance, including looking for standardized tests or benchmarking datasets.
Start implementing the new memory architecture by pulling and modifying the open-source GitHub repository.
Investigate prior work that uses the ICSI dataset, especially for memory-related tasks published after 2022.
Explore a two-step approach to model meeting 'style', specifically for handling interruptions, by first generating content and then applying a style model or flag.
Define and implement a core evaluation task to track the lifecycle of topics, specifically to identify 'dead topics' that were discussed but later abandoned.
Implement a pre-processing step to segment transcripts into smaller idea units before analysis to improve LLM performance and reduce hallucination.
Experiment with using function calling to allow the agent to dynamically decide which memory (short-term or long-term) to access or update based on sentence-level analysis.
